entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cyrus the Great, a notable figure in the history of Iran, associated with Median and Achaemenid Empires (559 BCE–486 BCE). Preceded by Medes and Babylonians sack Nineveh, ending the Assyrian Empire and Median Empire. Their legacy influenced Cyrus the Great conquers Babylon and issues the Cyrus Cylinder and Darius I builds Persepolis and reorganizes the empire into 20 satrapies.
